value.title: Transparent environment runtime
value.summary: Materialize harness-neutral environments whose declarations, observations, authority, reservations, and outcomes remain separately inspectable.
definition_of_done: Every fleet member sees the same typed environment identity, facilities, limits, live facts, missing facts, and published limitations.
Each mutable resource has one owning serialization point and all other views are freshness-bounded projections.
Observed environment facts, task requirements, allocation policy, and granted leases remain distinct records with explicit provenance and revision custody.
A task can submit a typed scheduling manifest for resource vectors, exclusivity, phase changes, and service class without overriding fleet fairness policy.

The agent control plane follows a user-space microkernel boundary: a small authority owns identity, lifecycle, resource ledgers, and the event journal while workspace, build, browser, network, and harness adapters remain replaceable services.

NixOS and Linux remain the host substrate; systemd and cgroup-v2 task scopes provide the first enforceable resource domains, with microVM execution available as an explicit higher-boundary task class rather than the universal default.
Multiple host environments federate through versioned messages and observations as a multikernel-style system without pretending that their mutable state is shared.

value.title: Federated environment directory and placement
value.summary: Register multiple independently governed machine environments and place work through explicit observations and local lease grants without introducing shared mutable capacity.
definition_of_done: The single-host runtime is one EnvironmentPort instance identified by an opaque stable environment ID; no caller relies on an ambient global environment.
Every observation, task manifest, lease, receipt, and event carries environment identity, boot incarnation, schema version, local revision, and observation time where applicable.
An EnvironmentDirectory projects registered descriptors and freshness without becoming the authority for any environment's local resource ledger.

A placement planner compares freshness-bounded candidate observations, requests an idempotent local reservation from the selected environment, and compensates unused or failed reservations without claiming a cross-host atomic transaction.
Environment disappearance, restart, partition, and stale observation remain distinct explicit states; a hostname or transport connection is never treated as durable environment identity.

Capabilities remain issuer-scoped and non-transferable by default; supervisors can delegate only a narrowed child grant within the issuing environment unless an explicit cross-environment protocol produces a new local grant.
Control Room can project environment topology, capacity bands, placements, leases, and evidence while linking every projection to its local authority and revision.

attributes.work.prior-art: Barrelfish multikernel, distributed lease protocols, and scheduler placement manifests

value.title: Heterogeneous capability topology and placement research
value.summary: Match task needs and preferences against typed compute, accelerator, storage, network, device, locality, and host-role capabilities within and across environments.
definition_of_done: An environment describes a resource topology rather than one flat capacity number: CPU classes and affinity, GPU or accelerator devices and memory, storage and data locality, network position, attached facilities, and declared host role remain separately typed.

Discovered facts, operator-declared roles, benchmark observations, and planner assumptions retain different evidence kinds and freshness; device presence alone never implies a usable runtime, driver, toolchain, or workload fit.

Capability kinds distinguish an agent execution slot, a typed service or device operation, an observation source, and artifact or data locality, so using a router or media-server facility does not require launching a general agent on that host.
Task manifests distinguish hard requirements from ranked preferences, fallbacks, affinity or anti-affinity, data locality, expected phases, and disruption tolerance.

Placement produces an explainable candidate ranking and an explicit no-fit result before requesting a local lease; media, routing, workstation, build, browser, and accelerator hosts can therefore keep different role policies.
A granted device or accelerator slice has one local owner and an issuer-scoped lease; cross-host planning never fabricates a portable GPU, storage, or network capability.

A deterministic tracer covers homogeneous cores, heterogeneous CPU cores, a GPU or AI accelerator, a storage-local media task, a network-local appliance task, capability disappearance, and an honest no-fit rejection.

value.title: Reusable repository shape
value.summary: Compose versioned domain policies, capabilities, generators, migrations, agent guidance, and conformance gates into the PBK program shape.
definition_of_done: A repository can adopt and update a versioned PBK shape while retaining explicit local ownership and deviations.
One declarative profile drives an interactive builder, a typed programmatic API, non-interactive agent input, and deterministic generated artifacts.
Frontend profiles deploy to Cloudflare Workers through Alchemy v2, while Bun remains the local package and task runtime.
Every frontend profile installs Axe and escalates tests from Vitest to Browser Mode to Playwright at explicit behavior boundaries.
Reef can audit and reconcile an existing repository through versioned migrations, exception records, and evidence without erasing local product decisions.
Generator backends are adapters; Nx generators are evaluated first, while non-Nx repositories remain supported.

value.title: Kernel diagnostic-fact custody correction

definition_of_done: Type-valued and row-valued diagnostic facts register through the existing strict table-reference decoder and reject malformed or dangling references.
Generated invalid programs and a byte-exact cross-host fixture prove that every returned rejection satisfies the public guard and canonical encoders.
Open diagnostic-fact records traverse keys in Unicode code-point order, so value and canonical-byte decoding preserve the same first-encounter table authority.
